summary: Review onboarding content for expectation setting, task success, permission/commitment proportionality and recovery from blocked states.

must_inspect.why: The sequence should connect setup work to an observable first value without hiding prerequisites.
false_positive_guards: Do not call an intentional expert workflow too complex without audience evidence.

must_inspect.why: Requests for access, data, integrations or invitations should be justified before commitment.
false_positive_guards: Review communicated rationale; hand runtime permission behavior to web-app-auditor or repo-roaster.

must_inspect.why: Blocked or failed onboarding needs a recoverable next step for material dead ends.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand recovery copy for impossible states without evidence they are reachable.
